name: Tamsin
fantasy: A rink-keeper from the high frosts. She runs the fight on the ice: homing darts, a spear that freezes where it lands, and a sliding wall of ice that shoves foes where she wants them.
silhouette: the big furred collar and the long trailing scarf, on blade skates

card.role: Ice controller: homing darts, a freezing spear and a sliding ice wall.
card.loop: Ice controller: homing darts, a freezing spear and a sliding ice wall.
card.lmb: Ice Dart: hold for a stream of slow darts that curve onto the foe at your cursor.
card.rmb: Ice Spear: lands at the cursor, slows there, and bursts and freezes 1.8s later.
card.e: Rink Wall: an ice wall slides toward the cursor, widening and shoving foes; E again freezes it.
card.dash: Skate: hold Shift to skate where you move; your darts fly straight and hit 1.6x harder.
card.passive: Hoarfrost: hits Chill; 8 darts on one foe, or knocking a Chilled foe, Shatters them.

weapons.hoar_fan: Hold for a stream of slow darts that curve onto the foe at your cursor.

passive.name: Hoarfrost
passive.desc: Your damaging abilities Chill foes for 4s (a Chilled foe is a little slower and shows frost). Eight darts on the same foe Shatter them: a starburst of ice spikes, 60 damage to everyone within 2.4m. Knocking a Chilled hunter, or felling a Chilled monster, Shatters them 0.4s later: 30 damage to everyone within 3m, plus Chill.

dash.name: Skate
dash.desc: Hold Shift to skate at 8 m/s where you move, for up to 2.4s, steering gently; you carry on over ledges. Let go and you stop; stopping early gives back a share of the cooldown. While skating your darts fly straight and thick and hit 1.6x. In the air this is your usual long dash.

variants.tap: Hold to see the landing ring at the cursor (up to 12m); let go to throw. The spear lands at the cursor (4 damage to a foe in the way, where it then lands) and leaves a 2.2m slow zone (35% slower, Chill) for 1.8s, then detonates: 60 damage in 2.7m and a 0.5s freeze. 2 charges.

e.name: Rink Wall
e.desc: A 0.2s sparkle at your feet, then a narrow block of ice erupts just ahead and slides toward the cursor (3 to 10.8m), widening from 1.8m to 4.5m, stopping enemy shots and shoving foes it touches. It stands 3s. Press E again while it slides to freeze it in place for 6s.

rank3.dash: a Skate over open sky lays a short ice bridge (a visual for now)

rank_next.sec: Rank 3: cooldown 7s -> 5.6s, damage +30%; the detonation is 30% larger.
rank_next.dash: Rank 3: recharge 8.5s -> 6.8s; a Skate over open sky lays a short ice bridge.
rank_next.kin: Rank 3: cooldown 17s -> 13.6s, wall strength +30%; +40 wall strength.

tells.half: a frost glow on foes that grows with each dart
tells.full: at 8 darts the foe Shatters in ice spikes; a landed spear shows its slow zone and fill to everyone
tells.dash_spent: skate blades dark, dash pip dark
